image_description: A vintage black typewriter viewed from the front. The image focuses on the keyboard area, specifically highlighting the long, horizontal key at the bottom center, which is the space bar. The space bar has ornate gold detailing and text inscribed on it. Above the keyboard are rows of round, black keys with white characters. The background shows the mechanical carriage and paper roller of the typewriter.
